svg.text: FinTracker — centralized logging, tracing and audit
Dev today: everything in the dev account's CloudWatch. Prod later adds a monitoring and log-archive account. Numbers follow one incident from request to record.
every line, metric and span carries service + trace_id; no financial values
who did what to which record
CloudWatch console: one place to watch and investigate every service
one query across all log groups
5. investigate: dashboard → trace → logs for that trace_id
same instrumentation, log groups and audit()
one console for dev and prod
Until then, the dev account keeps its own audit group
and CloudTrail bucket; nothing here is built yet.
